title: Divisibility by pi of the other chart equations
statement: For compatible prepared data R,Cbar,pi,d [lem-weil-pbc-popescu-lift-preparation], fix k and the explicit chart D_k and chartMap constructed in [lem-weil-pbc-popescu-lift-partial-chart-dimension]. Let q be any prime of the full lifting algebra D avoiding the image of a_k. Put T=(D_k)_{q_k}, q_k the inverse image of q [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. For every other chart kprime and every equation index l, the image of p_kprime,l in T is pi*y for some y in T. This assertion does not assume flatness, equality of annihilators or membership of pi in q.

proof.text: In the explicit partial chart D_k, the polynomial key identity pi*p_kl=-a_k*u_l+sum h_klj*u_j is proved by mapping Prepared.relation into Q and distributing the finite sums. For l in E_k, u_l is a defining relation. For l outside E_k, p_kl is a defining relation and the key identity, with a_k invertible at the pullback prime, kills u_l. These steps are already proved by equation_key_identity and chart_original_equation_eq_zero.

proof.text: For fixed kprime,l and j in E_k, form b_j=a_kprime*h_klj-sum_{jprime in E_kprime}h_kprime,l,jprime*h_k,jprime,j. Comparing the two cleared expressions for a_k*a_kprime*f_l gives the zero conormal class with coefficients b_j on the chosen conormal basis. Prepared.conormal makes each b_j zero in Cbar localized at a_k. Using Prepared.kernel and surjectivity, clear finitely many denominators to put a_k^N*b_j in I+pi^2P.

source.place: Stacks Project, Tag 07CP (lemma-lifting), https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07CP; read from the online tag because the local TeX is absent.

proof.text: Prepared.relation implies a_k*I is contained in I_Ek+pi^2P. Multiply the preceding coefficient relations once more by a_k. Expand a_k*p_kprime,l-a_kprime*p_kl+sum h_kprime,l,jprime*p_k,jprime modulo pi; its z_j coefficients are b_j. All p_kl vanish in D_k, including l in E_k by normalization. Multiply by the common a_k^N and substitute f_j=pi*z_j for j in E_k. The result belongs to pi*D_k after inverting a_k. Divide by the unit power of a_k and pass to the local ring at q_k to obtain the claimed witness y.

lean.statement:
theorem chart_relations_pi_divisible {R : Type a} {Cbar : Type c}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing Cbar] [Algebra R Cbar] (π : R)
    [Algebra (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)) Cbar]
    [IsScalarTower R (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)) Cbar]
    (d : PopescuLiftPresentation R Cbar π) (hd : d.Prepared)
    (k : Fin d.r) (q : PrimeSpectrum d.liftingAlgebra)
    (hk : ULift.up (Ideal.Quotient.mk d.definingIdeal (d.includeX (d.a k))) ∉ q.asIdeal)
    : ∀ (k' : Fin d.r) (l : Fin d.m),
      ∃ y : d.chartLocal k q,
        algebraMap (d.chartAlgebra k) (d.chartLocal k q)
          (ULift.up (Ideal.Quotient.mk (d.chartIdeal k) (d.equation (.inr (k', l))))) =
            algebraMap R (d.chartLocal k q) π * y
